description: An iterator property holding a template is an error, even one giving a name
notes: The README doesn't say how the iterator attribute is read, and a JSON string is a template in most places, so a template giving the name it would be another reading. hashicorp/hcl reads the attribute with hcl.AbsTraversalForExpr (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go), for which the JSON syntax reads the string as a native syntax traversal, where a template sequence is an error.
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
